glosses: hood, fume hood (covering of a vent to suck away smoke or fumes)

examples.text: Tom hatte den Finger am Abzug.
examples.en: Tom had his finger on the trigger.

examples.text: Ich schloss meine Augen und drückte den Abzug.
examples.en: I closed my eyes and squeezed the trigger.

examples.text: Tom nahm den Finger vom Abzug.
examples.en: Tom took his finger off the trigger.

examples.text: Tom hatte nicht den Mut, den Abzug zu betätigen.
examples.en: Tom didn't have the courage to pull the trigger.
